findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_public_tenders" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search published tender notices by text, country, sector, category, CPV prefix, status, buyer, deadline window, estimated value and place. Returns compact hits …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
